capture.redaction: The id/key/name of every row is the literal captured value. Every 'value' payload was replaced with a neutral placeholder -- the live values carry instance network CIDRs, proxy config and DVR paths, and nothing in ECM's key->id resolution reads them.
capture.why: Pins the response SHAPE the key->id resolver must handle: a BARE JSON list (not a paginated envelope) of {id, key, name, value} rows, with NON-CONTIGUOUS ids that do not correlate with list position. The 7 keys are exactly the 7 that failed with PATCH 404 in the q6xjl doc-test run.
